C-SIDEBAR-MOVE-FILE.IntentSummary: One moveItem action in the project store (same-destination and destination-exists refusals, native mt_fs_move, open-tab pathname/filename/DIRNAME migration, table-layouts and reading-position entry migration, tree refresh, clipboard clearing) reached by two doors: sidebar drag-and-drop (treeFile rows draggable, treeFolder rows drop targets) and the existing cut+paste path rerouted through the action. Files only in v1; notices plain English per the sidebar precedent; rename flow untouched.

Corner.Situation: Drag a file onto the folder it already lives in (or paste into it)
Corner.Expected: refusal notice, no filesystem call, clipboard preserved for paste

Corner.Situation: Destination folder already contains a same-named file
Corner.Expected: refusal notice naming the file before any native call; nothing moves

Corner.Situation: Moved file is open in a tab (dirty and clean)
Corner.Expected: tab pathname/filename migrate; current file's DIRNAME updates; a subsequent save writes to the new path; buffer and dirty state unchanged

Corner.Situation: Moved file has stored table layouts / reading position
Corner.Expected: entries re-keyed to the new pathname (rename's RENAME_IF_NEEDED pattern)
error notice; tabs, stores, clipboard untouched

Corner.Situation: Moved file was the clipboard source
Corner.Expected: clipboard cleared on success; on failure it stays armed

Corner.Situation: Drop onto a file row, or drag a folder
Corner.Expected: no move — files are the only draggable v1 payload and folders are the only drop targets
identical behavior to drag-and-drop (same action, same refusals, same migrations)

T-001.Title: moveItem action in the project store

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Async moveItem(src, destDir): normalizes dest, refuses same-destination with the existing notice; refuses when the destination file exists (window.fileUtils.exists-style check or equivalent guarded read) with a notice naming the file; awaits fileUtils.move; migrates open tabs via the editor store (pathname/filename, DIRNAME for the current file); migrates table-layouts and reading-position entries mirroring rename's RENAME_IF_NEEDED; refreshes the tree the same way paste does today; clears the clipboard when its src matches; returns the move result and never throws uncaught.

The SIDEBAR::paste handler computes destDir from the active item exactly as today, then delegates to moveItem for cut sources (copy keeps the existing copy path); success/failure notices come from the action.

treeFile rows become draggable (dataTransfer carries the pathname); treeFolder rows accept dragover (drop-effect move, visual active state) and drop (calls moveItem); drops on non-folder surfaces are ignored; the component templates and store stay within the existing snabbdom/Vue patterns.

tests/renderer/store/project-move.test.js pins corners 1/2/3/5/6 with a mocked fileUtils and a minimal editor-store stub; a source-level pin asserts the dnd wiring and the paste rerouting; touched files carry updated MODULE_MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY headers; grace target assertions green during implementation, final with --run-commands green before handoff.
